text: U5 receipt: commit 8d2998e on branch stp-upstream in ~/code/scala/reframe4s-stp (unpushed). API: reframe4s.resample.{VolumeModulation {Unmodulated, Jacobian, SqrtJacobian} (not JacobianModulation, which stays ScalaFIM's adapter name), ModulationDiagnostics(min/max det, orientationReversingPoints, singularPoints), ModulatedResamplingPlan.compile(source: ContinuousImage, target: Grid, pull: SpatialMap[Target,Source,D], interpolation, modulation, boundary) with run(workspace), factorAt(index), plan, diagnostics; ResamplingError.DegenerateModulationAxis}. Tests: reframe4s-lawsJVM/test 50/50, reframe4s-lawsJS/test 48/48 (JVM has 2 extra JVM-only perf tests), resample JVM/JS 1/1; ModulatedResamplingSuite 8 new. Observed: Jacobian mass ratio within 1e-3 (0.99902..1.00004); SqrtJacobian energy ratio 0.9956..0.9975 (linear-interpolation bias ~ -h^2/(6 sigma^2)); other law off by >20%/>10%. Caveats: modulation uses |det| (reflections modulated by magnitude, folds reported only via counts); the determinant is FD of the pull on the target lattice, not reframe4s-field's DeterminantField (resample cannot depend on field).
